Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the digital marketing/SEO position at your company. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation in SEO, GEO, and web development, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to projects that value creativity, curiosity, and strategic thinking.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I have also developed mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. My experience with tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console has helped me make data-driven decisions that improve organic performance.

I am particularly drawn to your team's emphasis on ownership and growth. I thrive in environments where I can experiment, learn from feedback, and contribute to meaningful projects. I am eager to bring my skills in SEO, content, and web development to your team and help shape outcomes that matter.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute. Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the digital marketing/SEO role at your company. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), I am drawn to your team's values of creativity, curiosity, and strategic thinking. I believe my hands-on experience and passion for learning align well with the ownership and growth you foster.

Currently, at Episto, I manage on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content that drives organic traffic. I also build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring they are optimized for both users and search engines. My work is data-driven: I regularly use SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to guide decisions and measure performance.

On my own project, mirook.com, I have gone deeper into technical SEO and GEO. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project has taught me to iterate, audit, and refine—skills I am eager to apply to your clients' brands.

What excites me most about your team is the emphasis on ownership and experimentation. I am not afraid to try new approaches, challenge assumptions, and learn from feedback. I am also committed to continuous growth, as evidenced by my ongoing Dutch classes and my eagerness to expand into analytics and campaign support.

I would love the opportunity to contribute to projects that have real meaning and to help shape outcomes that matter. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
